details.description: Indulge in the delightful and nourishing experience of 24 Mantra's Organic Peanut Jaggery Chikki. Crafted with the finest organic peanuts and jaggery, this traditional Indian snack is a perfect pick-me-up when you need a burst of energy or a satisfying sweet treat. The rich, creamy peanuts are complemented by the unique, caramelised flavour of pure jaggery, creating a truly delectable and wholesome snack. Packed with protein, essential minerals, and natural sweetness, this chikki is a guilt-free indulgence that supports your overall well-being. Enjoy the clean, organic ingredients and the absence of any artificial additives or preservatives. Savour the authentic taste and texture of this time-honoured recipe, perfect for satisfying cravings and fuelling your day.
details.storageInstructions:
Away from direct sunlight.
Store in an airtight container.

details.description: Indulge in the delightful crunch and sweetness of 24 Mantra Organic Sesame Chikki, a beloved snack that delights taste buds across generations. Crafted with the finest quality organic sesame and jaggery, this chikki offers a rich, nutritious treat that is sure to bring a smile to your face. Bursting with the natural goodness of sesame, the chikki's crispy texture and delightful jaggery flavour make it a versatile snack that can be enjoyed at any time of the day, whether as a mid-morning pick-me-up, an afternoon treat, or a post-dinner delight. Packed with essential proteins and minerals, this organic snack is a wholesome choice for kids, youngsters, and adults alike, satisfying sweet cravings in a truly delicious and nourishing way.
details.ingredients:
Sesame, Jaggery and Sugar. Ingredients with are Organic. Contains Sesame.
Jaggery and sugar only. No liquid glucose/corn syrup is used. Produced in a facility that also handles Wheat, Soy, Peanuts, Mustard and Tree Nuts.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in a cool, dry place. Avoid direct sunlight.
